title: 保免攔除(1867;Bodleian Sinica 2044) / Bao mian lan chu [Preventing and averting illness]: Transcription dataset
description:
《保免攔除》（Bao mian lan chu；1867）是 Frederick Porter Smith 的晚清漢語醫學與日常保健小冊，Bodleian Sinica 2044 著錄刊地為漢皋（Hankow），題頁署寶善居舍藏板。書中討論居室、飲食、精神與身體活動、潔身及多科病症，並連結基督教語彙，可供醫學翻譯、傳教士出版與晚清生活史研究。本資料集依21幅影像提供36個指定物理面的 TXT、JSON、TEI XML、疑讀與來源對應。文字為 AI 暫定轉錄並經局部原圖修訂，未經人類全文雙校或專家審定。

Bao mian lan chu [Preventing and averting illness] is an 1867 Chinese medical and everyday-health booklet by Frederick Porter Smith. Bodleian Sinica 2044 is catalogued as published in Hankow; the title page names Baoshan jushe as block holder. Its discussions of housing, diet, mental and physical activity, cleanliness and medical conditions, linked with Christian vocabulary, support research on medical translation, missionary publishing and late-Qing everyday life. Based on 21 images, the dataset provides TXT, JSON and TEI XML for 36 designated physical faces, with uncertainties and source mappings. The provisional AI transcription includes selected source-image corrections; full human double collation and expert review have not been performed.

Prior v0.2.0 DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23975561; this proposed v0.2.1 DOI is unknown and omitted.

# Methods / 處理方法

v0.2.1 applies a targeted, nonblind review of 4 selected reader questions against the same fixed Bodleian images. Proposed readings and their rationale were already known before image review. Full parent frames were viewed together with original-pixel details where needed. 1 individually specified literal operations (1 codepoints) are adopted; retained and unresolved proposals are listed with source references in TARGETED-CORRECTIONS.json. This round is not a fresh whole-book independent collation.



The previous v0.2.0 whole-book AI observation, comparison and source-adjudication history remains preserved in HISTORICAL-METHODS-v0.2.0.md and the existing JSON history. Its coverage and failed or incomplete activities are not upgraded by this selected review. Historical count statements describe that version; current counts are 364 units, 8031 literal Unicode codepoints and 570 active uncertainty declarations. Codepoint counts include reference strings where present and are not source character counts or error rates.

No Unicode normalization, global variant or punctuation replacement, reading-order change, gaiji-ID change, or modernization is applied. Fixed unit strings drive the JSON, TXT and TEI XML exports without new model rewriting. Unknown glyph extent remains unknown; original uncertainties and superseded readings remain in version history. The two current gaiji reference notations, where present, remain unchanged.

Full human double collation, expert review, peer review and accuracy measurement have not been performed. Exact model identifiers, reasoning settings and complete token counters for the native AI review were not reported and remain unknown. Format, schema, hash and round-trip checks establish engineering properties only. The minimal TEI P5 projection is not a complete scholarly apparatus; no custom ODD or Schematron is claimed.

Source scans and crops, dedicated programs, prompts and complete private working records are excluded. The complete image-to-text production method is not publicly reproducible from this package. See RIGHTS.md and LICENSE.md for the distinct historical-text, original-documentation and Bodleian-image terms. This is historical-document transcription; no biological research or modern clinical instructions are provided.
